query:
SELECT TOP 100 g.source_id AS gaia_source_id,g.random_index,g.ra,g.dec,g.ref_epoch,g.pmra,g.pmdec,g.parallax,g.parallax_over_error,g.phot_g_mean_mag,g.ruwe,g.duplicated_source,g.phot_variable_flag,g.non_single_star,g.astrometric_params_solved,g.b,g.classprob_dsc_combmod_star,ap.*
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g JOIN gaiadr3.astrophysical_parameters AS ap ON g.source_id=ap.source_id
WHERE g.random_index BETWEEN 1000000 AND 100000000 AND ABS(g.b)>20 AND g.phot_g_mean_mag BETWEEN 8 AND 13 AND g.ruwe<1.2 AND g.duplicated_source='false' AND g.non_single_star=0 AND g.phot_variable_flag<>'VARIABLE' AND g.astrometric_params_solved=31 AND g.parallax_over_error>10 AND g.classprob_dsc_combmod_star>0.99
AND ap.teff_gspspec_lower>=4900 AND ap.teff_gspspec_upper<=5200 AND ap.logg_gspspec_lower>=2.5 AND ap.logg_gspspec_upper<=3.5 AND ap.mh_gspspec_lower>=-0.5 AND ap.mh_gspspec_upper<=0
AND ap.flags_gspspec LIKE '0000000000000%'
ORDER BY g.random_index ASC
exclusion: random_index>=1000000, outside primary 10000 registry acquisition domain; explicitly remove 100 exposed v02 IDs
selection_order: SHA256 echolens-calibration-v10: plus exact source ID then numeric ID
selection_inputs: Gaia main/AP only; no WISE/2MASS values or residuals
status: comparison candidates; ordinary-star status not certified; GSPspec values raw/un-calibrated; no excess scoring
